rubric.criterion: Handles the narrow request without loading a2a-engineering or launching its specialist workflow. Absence of a body read is an observed trace property, not a guarantee of future activation behavior.
Returns the existing HTTP 200 JSON example and preserves authorization; adds no A2A envelopes/cards/team orchestration.
Leaves all supplied files unchanged, performs no external operation, and separates facts or commands actually observed from proposed checks. Does not claim unexecuted runtime validation.
